BrochureContent.Content:
Michael Pigott Auctioneer and Valuer is delighted to bring to the market for sale this sizeable three bedroom end of terrace semi-detached property situated in this mature residential area in Carrigaline. 

The property offers a nice mix of both living and bedroom accommodation over three floors consisting of 1,348 sq ft. It has a nice private rear garden that is totally maintenance free and it has the benefit of enjoying good privacy as well as having side access via a pedestrian gate. The house itself is in superb decorative order throughout having been nicely upgraded and modernized in recent years with a new modern fitted kitchen with integrated appliances, new boiler, new flooring in upper floors to name just a few. Anyone can see it is a really well cared for home having been tastefully presented by its current owners. 

It is most conveniently located within walking distance of all amenities & services in Carrigaline and is just a short commute to Cork City Centre, Cork Airport & Ringaskiddy. It has easy access to a regular public bus service available at the entrance to the park and is also just a short drive to a selection of local beaches such as Fountainstown & Myrtleville.  

Viewing of this ideal starter home in a most convenient position in Carrigaline comes highly recommended.

Size: 125.4 sq metres (1,348sq ft) 
Gas Fired Central Heating
PVC Double Glazed Windows & Doors
Modern extensive fitted kitchen with integrated appliances
Superb decorative order throughout
Spacious living & bedroom accommodation
Private rear garden with side access
Small and convenient residential location
Easy access to regular public bus service
Minutes’ walk to all amenities & services to Carrigaline
Short commute to Cork City Centre, Cork Airport & Ringaskiddy.

From the main street of Carrigaline continue straight up the hill past ‘The Corner House’ pub on the right hand side. At the top of the hill continue through the crossroads and take your first left in to ‘Clover Hill’ estate. Upon entering the estate, keep left and follow the road around to the right. Keep left and left again and No.17 White Oaks is facing you, indicated by our "For Sale" sign. Follow Eircode: P43 CT82
